title: einvoice conformance schema index
description: Plain catalog of the adopter-facing EN 16931 / XRechnung conformance JSON Schemas published under einvoice/. It carries NO rule logic and NO hashes of the schema bodies: every field below is re-derivable by reading the listed schema files, and test_schema_index.py proves the catalog stays in sync (completeness + $id/title fidelity + version consistency). Consumers can use it to discover the stable $id, title, filename and version of each published schema.
